link.note: Tree only and contradicted: Carmine Fiorillo's 1860 death act names his mother Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli, not Maria. Morrello is absent from San Mango's 1674-1804 stati delle anime. Do not treat as an ancestor until proven.

summary: Tree's mother of Carmine Fiorillo; superseded by Vittoria Marrelli (confirmed). Possibly a garbled or mis-attached version of her.
bio: Tree: Maria Morrello (1786-1846), wife of Domenico G. Fiorillo; parents Vincenzo Morrello M... (1759-1836) + Ippolita Guercio N... (1761-1831). Round 2: Morrello/Morello has 0 entries in San Mango's stati 1674-1804, including fuzzy spellings, and the couple would have been listed in 1800/1804. Round 3: Carmine's death act gives 'Vittoria Marrelli/Morelli'. The whole Morrello/Guercio/Chiarello pedigree above her is flagged unsupported.
openQuestions: Is she the same person as Vittoria Marrelli (different given name), or a mis-attachment from another family's tree?
